notes.title: Troubleshooting 'black screen' issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've recently received multiple reports that the game only comes with a black screen when it's run in full-screen. We assume that this bug is related to recent Windows 10 updates, and we also found that several other GameMaker: Studio based games are experiencing similar problems.

To solve this issue, you should run the game in compatibility mode. Please follow the steps below.
[list][*][b]1.[/b] Navigate to the game folder.
[list][*][b]1-1.[/b] Right-click the game(SPLIT BULLET) in your Steam library, and select "Properties".
[*][b]1-2.[/b] Click "Local Files" tab and press "Browse Local Files..." button to open folder.[/list]
[*][b]2.[/b] Right-click "SPLIT_BULLET.exe" and select "Properties(R)".
[*][b]3.[/b] Move to "Compatibility" tab, and enable "Run this program in compatibility mode for:" checkbox under the "Compatibility Mode" section. (Windows 8 will be set by default, so you won't have to touch the drop-down list.)[/list]

Since this problem is OS/engine-related, it seems that there's no fundamental solution right now. Following all of the steps above will fix the problem, for now.

We apologize for any inconvenience. Thank you.

tags.bug: We assume that this bug is related to recent Windows 10 updates, and we also found that several other GameMaker: Studio based games are experiencing similar problems.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE May 27, 2017
notes.content:
[h1]In-Game & User Interfaces[/h1]
[list][*][b]Major changes on overall interface structure[/b]
We received several feedback that the interface does not match the game. We changed the structure of the overall interface significantly, including font. To briefly compare the differences:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/ce364201d8aeb66c8d539fe08356b0d10428c3f8.png[/img]


[*][b]Redesigned icons of weapons and skills[/b]
The previous icons were hard to figure out what kind of attack the weapon fires. We've redesigned the icons to make it more intuitive. Check out the difference:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/3e5465185e16f72847174ac6324b0d3e5b9ac0ef.png[/img]


[*][b]Anti-alias[/b]
We have trimmed the aliases which appeared in some enemies, especially triangular ones.


[*][b]Controller Support[/b]
Now the game provides full controller support! Every menu in the game can be navigated using the controller. Current default key settings are:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/f8ea424eaa449194aa4b11391dfc9c8bf9348d86.png[/img]
We are still discussing whether to change the roles of bumpers(LB, RB) and triggers(LT, RT). We will make decisions based on user feedbacks—or adding a key configuration options may be a solution.[/list]


[h1]Steamworks[/h1]
[list][*][b]Achievements[/b]
The achievements are finally here! There are 15 achievements now(including 4 hidden ones!), and more will be added soon! If you have any idea, please share it; we will reflect it in future updates.

[list][*][b]Hello World![/b]
Run the game for the first time

[*][b]a²d²B²[/b]
Defeat 'Bad Squares'

[*][b]Hexagons are the Bestagons[/b]
Defeat 'Hexagonal'

[*][b]Like a Record[/b]
Defeat 'Hyper Spin'

[*][b]New World Order?[/b]
Defeat 'Trianglism'

[*][b]Points, Lines, Planes[/b]
Defeat 'Geometry'

[*][b]Identical[/b]
Defeat 'Twins'

[*][b]Smoothly done[/b]
Defeat 'Surface'

[*][b]88 mph[/b]
Defeat 'Time'

[*][b]Revelation[/b]
Defeat 'Space'

[*][b]Let There Be Light[/b]
Defeat 'Reverse'

[*][b]???[/b]
[i]Hidden achievement[/i]

[*][b]???[/b]
[i]Hidden achievement[/i]

[*][b]???[/b]
[i]Hidden achievement[/i]

[*][b]???[/b]
[i]Hidden achievement[/i][/list]


[*][b]Trading Cards[/b]
Steam Trading Cards and related items were added! There're 10 cards in total, plus 10 emoticons and 5 Steam Profile Backgrounds.

[list][*][b]Cards[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/e83be8dbf1aff9085b63ccf09a188ccf3ae8beea.png[/img]

[*][b]Badges[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/9be17eae5da97d59989daec1ac03086d87fb5b7b.png[/img]

[*][b]Emoticons[/b]
Emoticons carries icons of weapons and skills. To find out what it looks like, please check out the [b]Redesigned icons of weapons and skills[/b] section in this patch note.

[*][b]Steam Profile Backgrounds[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26603324/aa0df8a3b32c2dfdbb9a5578fb3d1f0496c54b60.png[/img][/list][/list]


[h1]Pricing[/h1]
As more content was added, we raised the price from $1.99 to $3.99. Prices in other regions would have been raised at a similar rate. But we promise that [b]we'll hold sales more often, at larger discount rates[/b]. The previous price was hard to do so.



[b][i]P.S.[/i][/b] We apologize for the long blank period before the update. We would like to express our sincere appreciation for your continued interest and encouragement. As always, thank you for playing, and we hope you have a nice day.

[list]
[*]Stage 9('Space') Boss's hit point has decreased.

[*]The shots of Weapon 4(Laser gun) remains longer than before.

[/list]

[/list]
